title: Prototype Measurements
description: Real physical-prototype measurements for Stage 5 (issue #91) to validate calculated URDF inertia against. Not produced by any current pipeline stage -- future hardware-measurement work (relates to issue #8's <2% inertia error success criterion) would populate a real 02_Design_Inputs/prototype_measurements.json matching this schema. Any field may be null (unmeasured) -- Stage 5 skips comparisons for null fields.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when measurements were taken

measurement_method.description: How/what equipment measured these values (e.g., 'scale + accelerometer', null if unmeasured)

link_measurement.description: Mass and inertia measurements for a single link (all fields optional/nullable)

com_mm.description: Center of mass [x, y, z] in millimeters (null if unmeasured)

inertia_kg_mm2.description: Moment of inertia tensor in kg·mm² (null if unmeasured)

ixx.description: Principal moment about X axis (always non-negative)

iyy.description: Principal moment about Y axis (always non-negative)

izz.description: Principal moment about Z axis (always non-negative)
